estimates.anchor_source: Options-implied smile RND for 12 Feb 2027 by total-variance interpolation between the 15 Jan 2027 and 19 Mar 2027 expiries at the 16 Sep close (ATM 37.7%, forward $170.25), yfinance chain captured 2026-09-17T03:12Z; no Polymarket/Kalshi market on the February price
estimates.independence_flag: NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_DERIVED by the 10-point rule on the thresholds; the decomposition is independent (median $6.7 below the anchor) and the thresholds coincide because the team's negative 5 Nov view and the positive February print history roughly cancel (research-log.md section 5)

feb_print_event.note: 5 of 6 positive (the brief's 6 of 6 is the calendar-February excess return); mean +7.9%, shrunk to +2.0 to +4.0% by 5 Nov branch
feb_print_event.comp: 1Q27 revenue guide against 1Q26 +17.9%; every Q4 print since 2022 has guided a decelerating Q1

model.structure: ln P(12 Feb) = ln P(15 Dec) + branch drift (+1.0/-1.0/-1.0/-3.0%) + Jan/Feb seasonal +2% + diffusion(39 sessions, 29%) + Feb day-1 event (+4.0/+2.5/+2.5/+2.0%, sd 8-8.5%)

sensitivity.assumption: Nov-branch drifts to Feb at half strength

monitoring.action: quote median $165, P(<=150) 0.34, P(<=143) 0.27, P(>=180) 0.35; memo's $138-148 is the 20th-33rd percentile
